name: for_loop_factorial_array
source:
{ A FOR loop that fills an array from a recursive FUNCTION.
  Java ProceduralFeaturesTest.milestone3FactorialAndArrays: f[1..5] = 1,2,6,24,120. }
FUNCTION Factorial(n)
  IF n <= 1 THEN
    Factorial := 1
  ELSE
    Factorial := n * Factorial(n-1)
  END
END

FOR i = 1 TO 5
  f[i] = Factorial(i)
END
